summary: Bilateral fixture for the curl glob_set switch-expression (int*) cast churn. Eight synthetic IR/CFG/type states (aligned, pa_out_int8, pa_in_churn, pa_both_churn, ia_token, cast_chain, globform, typedef_typelock) are seeded identically on both sides and run through the real ActionSetCasts::apply; each op's inputs/outputs (varnode + high, read-facing), TypeOp output token, apply-side output token, PTRSUB/PTRADD slot-0 input cast, the post-apply op graph with inserted CASTs, the count delta, and (globform) the rendered switch-expression tree are dumped. Phase B fixed the apply-side gaps (opUndoPtradd finalize semantics, apply PTRADD/PTRSUB fit preflight, castOutput PTRADD/implied/testStructOffset0 arms, castInput double-cast guard + const arm + markExplicit, TypeOpIntAdd/arithmetic-family arithmeticOutputStandard tokens); both streams are byte-identical and all 13 former known_raw_differences are retired. F2 follow-up (COREACTION-ISOPIDENTICAL-TYPEDEF-0001): the typedef_typelock case locks cc:2562-2567 force=!isOpIdentical(td_int8,int8) over an implied+typelock typedef-typed output; isOpIdentical's typedef-chain strip (cc:2476-2479) keeps force false so no CAST is inserted (count=1 comes from slot1 markExplicitUnsigned; negative control: the pre-fix pointer-only comparison forces a spurious CAST, count=2 + extra cast op).
